01-water.mo: a water tracker with a glass that fills up toward my daily goal, quick buttons for 250 and 500 ml
02-habits.mo: track my daily habits with a tick box each day and show streaks
03-exercise.mo: log my workouts: exercise, sets, reps and weight, with a chart of progress
04-budget.mo: simple monthly budget: income, expenses by category and what is left
05-journal.mo: a private daily journal where I write an entry and pick a mood
06-habits-plus.mo: habit tracker with week strips for each habit and a 10 week heat grid
07-exercise-plus.mo: workout log with personal bests, a weekly summary and a rest timer
08-budget-plus.mo: budget app with category bars, a monthly limit and a spending trend
09-journal-plus.mo: journal with moods over time, search and a writing streak
10-prayer-log.mo: tick off my five daily prayers and see how many I kept this week
11-medicine.mo: medicine reminder: name, dose, times per day, and tick when taken
12-study-timetable.mo: weekly study timetable with subjects, time slots and an exam countdown

21-grocery.mo: grocery list I can tick off while shopping
22-todo.mo: to do list with done checkboxes and a count of what is left
